summary: Creates smooth bridging geometry between curve, polygon, surface, or mesh pairs without altering the original input shapes.

key_params.name: cut
key_params.note: Cut source primitives at the fillet.

common_gotchas: Fillet SOP does not consider trim curves; use Join SOP when trim-curve handling is required.
Circular fillets ignore tangent scale magnitude except for sign.
`cut` and `seamless` can change how source primitives appear in the output, so do not assume originals are always untouched.
key_concepts: Fillet SOP creates smooth bridging primitives between pairs of curves, polygons, surfaces, or meshes.
Left and right primitive semantics follow Align SOP style group/increment selection.
`fillettype`, `primtype`, and `order` define the shape and primitive family of the generated bridge.
`seamless` and `cut` control how the original primitives appear together with the new fillet output.
